request.description:
Creates a new lead. `business_name`, `industry`, and `location` are required. `website` and `notes` are optional.

The test script auto-saves `lead_id` for use in subsequent requests.

response.name: 201 Created

request.description:
Returns paginated list of leads with meta information.
All query params are optional.
Example: filter leads by industry and status.
Fetch a single lead. Requires `lead_id` variable (auto-set by Create Lead).

Partial update — only send fields you want to change.
Allowed: business_name, industry, location, website, notes, status
Permanently deletes a lead and all related interactions (cascade).
Uses Claude AI to score the lead 0–100 based on their profile. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env.
